backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the removal of all 🥺 emoji instances from frontend files App.tsx, CelebrationScreen.tsx, and RunawayButton.tsx, with high confidence and linked to test REQ-25.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of each frontend source file describing their Slytherin/Harry Potter theme, emoji changes, and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with title 'Come Back Saachi' that mounts the React app at the #root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering a Slytherin-themed page with a floating particles background, a MainCard asking Saachi to reconnect, and a CelebrationScreen shown after the user clicks Yes.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationScree: Celebration component that displays Slytherin-colored confetti, floating magical emoji particles, and a sequentially animated card with heartfelt messages after the user says yes.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Background decoration component rendering 22 randomly positioned Harry Potter-themed emoji particles that float upward with varied speeds and opacities.
frontend/src/components/RunawayButton.ts: A 'No' button that runs away on hover/touch and displays one of 20 Harry Potter-themed quips (with all 🥺 emojis removed), repositioning itself randomly around the viewport.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a Slytherin/Harry Potter dark theme with OKLCH CSS custom properties, Tailwind base/utilities imports, custom utility classes, and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with Slytherin-palette OKLCH color tokens, custom fonts (Cinzel, Crimson Text), border radii, box shadows, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot documenting the app's purpose (a Harry Potter-themed page asking Saachi to reconnect), architectural rules, known issues, and existing feature list at version 27.
